data.name: Hubaab
data.gender_notes: Hubaab is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hubaab is derived from the Arabic word 'hubb', which means 'love'. Hubaab is a name that signifies a soft, gentle wind that carries the fragrance of love. It is a name that embodies the qualities of gentleness, tenderness, and strength. The name Hubaab carries the meaning “Soft, gentle wind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hubaab usually hope their child will grow to embody soft, gentle wind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hubaab is a name that represents the gentle breeze of Allah's mercy and love. It is a name that reminds us of the comforting presence of Allah and the tender love that He holds for His creation.
data.etymology: Hubaab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soft, gentle wind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hubaab total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hindi.name: हुबाब
in_hindi.meaning: हुबाब का अर्थ है बारिश की तरह गिरना, प्रिय लगना
in_hindi.long_meaning: हुबाब एक अरबी नाम है जो हिंदी में भी प्रयोग होता है। इसका अर्थ है बारिश की तरह गिरना या नदी की तरह बहना। यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है और इसके अर्थ प्रेम और प्यार से भी जुड़े हुए हैं। इस्लामी इतिहास में हबाब बिन अल-हज्जाज का उल्लेख मिलता है जो एक प्रसिद्ध सहाबी और हदीस के रावी थे। इस नाम के महत्व को देखते हुए यह मुस्लिम माता-पिता के बीच लोकप्रिय हुआ है जो अपने बच्चों के लिए आध्यात्मिक और अर्थपूर्ण नाम ढूंढते हैं।

in_english.name: Hubaab
in_english.long_meaning: Hubaab is a name of Arabic origin. It means to descend like rain or to flow like a river. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'hub' which relates to love or affection. In Islamic history, Habbab bin al-Hajjaj was a notable companion of the Prophet and a narrator of Hadith. The name holds significance in Islamic tradition and is chosen by Muslim parents for its spiritual and meaningful connotations. It symbolizes a person who brings blessings and prosperity, much like the rain that nourishes the earth.

Hubaab is a name that reflects the beauty and grace of these sacred relationships, reflecting the values of harmony, compassion, and devotion that are deeply rooted in Islamic tradition.

It is a name that serves as a reminder of the importance of love and compassion, both towards oneself and towards others. Ultimately, it is a name that inspires us to cultivate a deep and abiding love for Allah and for the world He has created.
